title: OL-20261122-2: Re-grade Unlearn entries when new reviews pile up
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** GET https://unlearn.ultrastable.org/api/review-queue.json returns a non-empty queue
**Done check:** grep:instances/unlearn/worker/evidence.js::export async function regrade
**Status:** closed

The evidence loop flags entries with 3 or more unreviewed new reviews at /api/review-queue.json; re-grading an entry (reading the new reviews into its grade and marking leads reviewed) is not yet automated.

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-22T11:01:10Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
